name: DeepSeek Sparse Attention · DSA
tagline: Score historical tokens, then attend to the selected keys.
description: A multi-head ReLU indexer scores historical tokens and selects a causal top-256 set for attention. The adaptation transfers the selection mechanism without importing the complete DeepSeek MLA, MoE or FP8 system.
mechanism: A 4 × 128 indexer, 64-dimensional partial RoPE and signed head weights
Gather attention over a causal top-256 token selection
The first 512 updates use dense burn-in and an internal attention teacher
limitations: A from-scratch native-MHA adaptation. Indexer, teacher and auxiliary backward paths all contribute to training cost.
